items.item:
2. A resume of a run waiting only for approval is refused.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a14_resume_without_unreachable_refused]
statements:
```text
wait_elapsed -/> state_change
resume -> resend(service_unreachable elements) ONLY
resume AND none_waiting_unreachable -> refused
cancel -> actor = owner AND run_not_ended
spool_emptied <- ended(succeeded | refused | cancelled) OR released(failed)
startup: in_flight -> unknown; running runs advanced by kernel before surface opens
```

verdicts.why: The selected test establishes that the run waits only for owner approval, detects refusal of resume, and verifies that the refusal leaves the run, approval, trace, attempts, and requests unchanged. It does not assert the invariant's elapsed-wait, cancel authorization/unended-run, spool cleanup/release, or startup recovery requirements, and its control only weakly exercises resending a service-unreachable element while the service remains down.
